{{< include _fan-chart.md >}}

<p class="hero-caption">The Oceanic Niño Index through September 2026, the El Niño signal behind much of the year-to-year swing in Colombia's rainfall, with a 24-month forecast and its 50% and 90% intervals. ::: {.hero-bio}
I'm a statistician from Cali, Colombia. I like data that moves through time, and most of what I know is about reasoning with it: state-space models, Kalman filters and honest uncertainty.

I spent six years at CIAT modelling climate and crops, then moved to industry machine learning. I currently work as an AI engineer. This site is where I write down what I learn, with code in R and Python.
:::
